{{Short description|Chemist, Pedagogue}}
[[File:Hilmi Ibar 2011.JPG|thumb|Hilmi Ibar (2011)]]
'''Hilmi İbar''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|Хилми Ибар}}) (born July 31, 1947, in [[Gnjilane]], [[FPR Yugoslavia]]) is professor of chemistry, former dean of the pedagogic faculty and former head of the ''International Office'' at the [[Trakya University]] in [[Edirne]].<ref>[http://dis.trakya.edu.tr/tr/genel-bilgiler/personel.html International Office of the Trakya University] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130407103119/http://dis.trakya.edu.tr/tr/genel-bilgiler/personel.html |date=2013-04-07 }}</ref> He is also vice president of the [[Balkan Universities Network]].<ref>[http://bsec.trakya.edu.tr Balkan Spring Education Conference in Edirne May 2010] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100430190246/http://bsec.trakya.edu.tr/ |date=2010-04-30 }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Hilmi Ibar received his BSi in chemistry at the [[University of Pristina (1969-1999)|University of Pristina]] in 1970, his MSi and doctorate after education at [[Aston University]] and the [[University of Missouri–Kansas City]] at the [[University of Zagreb]] 1978 and 1984.
He was lecturer (1974) and associate professor (1980) in chemistry at the Pristina University. Since 1996 he is professor for chemistry at the Trakya University Edirne and dean of the faculty pedagogic science 2005–2012. Hilmi Ibar is additionally engaged in different international education projects.<ref>[http://www.demokrattrakya.net/yazdir.asp?ID=5029 Hilmi Ibar in Varna Bulgaria] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723084348/http://www.demokrattrakya.net/yazdir.asp?ID=5029 |date=2011-07-23 }}</ref> Ibar is international advisor of [[Recep Gürkan]], mayor of Edirne, since 2014 and rector [[Erhan Tabakoglu]] since his election 2016.
